array.string: PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH; . /etc/tunnel/tunnel.env; export AUTOSSH_GATETIME=0; exec autossh -M 0 -N -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/etc/tunnel/known_hosts -i /etc/tunnel/id_ed25519 -R "172.18.0.1:${PORT}:127.0.0.1:1080" "tunnel@${OPENCO3}"
